description: npm renewal mechanism (coding-policy: dependency-management Freshness — 'Automate it where a scanner supports the ecosystem: a committed Dependabot or Renovate config'). Covers the two npm manifests (root package.json, container/agent-runner/package.json) plus the globally-installed npm packages pinned in container/Dockerfile (#796). Scoped via enabledManagers so it does not overlap the docker ecosystems handled by .github/dependabot.yml — Dependabot owns the base-image @sha256 pins in the same Dockerfile, Renovate owns the npm literals inside its RUN line; the two never touch the same text.

The custom.regex manager exists because no native manager reads `RUN npm install -g <pkg>@<version>`: Dependabot's docker ecosystem sees only FROM lines, and Renovate's npm manager sees only package.json. Without it those two pins would be unwatched — a pin with no scanner is rot, not reproducibility.

Package-rules mirror the repo's dependabot cadence: weekly, chore-typed commits, minor+patch grouped to keep the PR volume low; majors land as individual reviewable PRs. The agent-image globals are deliberately NOT grouped with the npm-manifest updates: a claude-code bump changes the agent's own runtime inside every container, so it is reviewed on its own rather than buried in a batch.

customManagers.description: Globally-installed npm packages in the agent image (container/Dockerfile `RUN npm install -g <pkg>@<version>`).

GitHub-sourced global in the agent image pinned to a tag (container/Dockerfile `RUN npm install -g <owner/repo>#<tag>`, #748). Watched via the github-tags datasource since the npm datasource above cannot resolve a GitHub ref.
